newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGS firm slightly on NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGS firm slightly on NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices firmed slightly in quiet trade on Tuesday amid a rise in NYMEX futures on technicals, players said.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane gained a quarter cent to deals heard done at 34.50 cents. Conway, Kansas, material stayed steady at 35.75/36.00 cents.
Belvieu ethane purity gained a half cent to place sellers at 19.75 cents.
Belvieu normal butane was also up at quarter at 39.00/39.25 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
